title: 36 Hours in Orlando
abstract: You can’t go far without stumbling upon a picturesque lake, and the area abounds with small regional museums.

title: 36 Hours in Orlando, Fla.
abstract: Beyond the theme parks, gator farms and citrus groves of Orlando, there are plentiful options that include museums, picturesque lakes, dive bars and gastro-pubs.

title: 36 Hours São Paulo, Brazil
abstract: São Paulo, South America’s biggest metropolis, is bustling with artistic and business energy, and relentless night life.

title: 36 Hours in São Paulo, Brazil
abstract: In this sprawling metropolis that anchors Brazil’s booming economy, the flaws — which include high prices and persistent drizzle — are no match for its teeming energy, which infuses everything from art to business to the city’s relentless night life.

title: 36 Hours in Hong Kong
abstract: Hong Kong’s coiffed professionals attract the world’s most inventive chefs to their city, while the nonstop shoppers get first shot at the latest in fashion and design.

title: 36 Hours in Hong Kong
abstract: That most cosmopolitan of metropolises, Hong Kong, is a city of contrasts, always reinventing itself.

title: 36 Hours in Seattle
abstract: This is one of the rare American cities where you can be outdoors year-round without either shivering or sweating.

title: 36 Hours in Seattle
abstract: Seemingly overnight, whole swaths of downtown and nearby neighborhoods — notably South Lake Union and the Pike-Pine Corridor — have transformed themselves into enclaves of restaurants, bars and galleries.

title: 36 Hours in Louisville
abstract: In the Derby City, a glass of fine bourbon and good conversation aren’t hard to find.

title: 36 Hours in Louisville, Ky.
abstract: The last decade has seen a cultural and civic blooming in Louisville, with new galleries, restaurants and performance spaces taking their place alongside the city’s stalwart attraction, the Kentucky Derby.
